department: Department of Physics (Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin GSAS)

funding.value: Guaranteed funding for the first five years for all PhD students
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

entry_route.value: Open to holders of a BA/BS or equivalent; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

app_fee.quote: The application fee is $105 payable by credit card.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 95 (tests before Jan 21, 2026) or 5 (new scale), with Speaking 23 / 4.5; IELTS Academic also accepted; some programs may set higher scores
toefl_min.quote: Earning a minimum score of 5 (95 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026) on the TOEFL iBT and a minimum Speaking score of 4.5 (23 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026).

english_waiver.value: Exempt if your undergraduate degree is from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction; a master's or other graduate degree does not count
english_waiver.quote: Receiving an undergraduate degree from an academic institution where English is the primary language of instruction. | A master’s degree or other graduate degree is not accepted as proof of English proficiency.

notes: Department site (physics.harvard.edu) blocked automated fetches (403), so facts come from Harvard Griffin GSAS pages. GSAS accepts up to three applications per year to different programs, each with its own fee.
